about.title: Gabriel Vancini
paragraphs: I work as a full stack developer with emphasis on web development, integrations, and production environments. My approach is practical: understand context, choose a viable solution, and deliver with technical care.
I am especially comfortable in lean projects and short-term engagements, particularly when a real system needs to evolve without inflating scope, complexity, or operations.
